placement.rationale: Mid-cap placement balances the full-size fractions alongside existing letters and figures without exceeding current line metrics. Top placement descends more deeply; bottom placement rises above the existing Windows ascent.
placement.historical_limit: No co-set historical text baseline has been established. The row-median center at350 and35-unit sidebearings are modern layout choices. Full native dimensions and between-form differences are preserved.
placement.source_gap: Seek a matching eighteen-point fraction setting alongside letters or ordinary figures to establish historical baseline placement.
placement.scale_status: Crossbook shape comparisons support one isotropic scale per page; no individual height normalization or claim of identical physical matrices.

atf-handy-1897.method: Independent common-capital and repeated-footer physical scale.

atf-new-york-1897.method: Reviewed whole-form width/height fit to matching Handy fractions and symbols; one isotropic scale per source.

atf-handy-byu-1897.method: Reviewed whole-form width/height fit to matching Handy fractions and symbols; one isotropic scale per source.

footer_scale_transfer.method: Map 26 footer projection groups using threshold 170, combining the overlapping R/S pair in FOUNDERS. Measure ink bounds independently at five thresholds. Fit one isotropic 2D similarity transform to matched group centers. No fraction dimensions enter the fit.

quality_decisions: Reviewed all eight PDF pages:110threshold trials from22whole impressions.
New York supplies smoother complete first four fractions and cent sign. Its percent has a damaged upper connection and several threshold-sensitive holes; the intact Handy percent is preferred.
New York one-half uses170 to retain faint gray ink at the middle of the slash without a notch; lower thresholds introduce pinholes or irregular edges.
BYU supplies higher-resolution whole thirds/eighths. Three-eighths190 retains smoother numerator lower-right contour; five-eighths170 recognizes faint native ink without tracing printing pinholes.
BYU seven-eighths110 avoids a small dark paper/ink spur along the lower slash while retaining all four separate components and both eight counters.

Intentional slash interruptions are retained. Lower-resolution Handyfive-eighths bridges the slash into numerals and Handyseven-eighths merges components at150+; use the clearer separated BYU impressions.
identity_limit: Matched form construction and proportional dimensions support grouping; identical historical punches or matrices are not established.
